cpu_metric: cgroup total_usage delta / local monotonic midpoint wall delta * 100 (one core)
memory_metric: sampled cgroup max(0, usage - total_inactive_file [v1] or inactive_file [v2]) bytes
timing: 1s one-shot Docker Unix API sample schedule
viewer_bytes_metric: QA relay successful writes to and reads from /viewer/view.sock, HTTP+WebSocket bytes
